action.description: start: open a run with its outcome, endpoint and criteria. get: the run, the current revision and pending evidence. list: this thread's runs. advance: move to phase (one step forward, or back to repair). block: record a blocker in note. resume: clear it, with the decision in note. evidence: record one check's result. revise: add a criterion, or replace the one with its id and drop its evidence; not while blocked.

criteria.description: start: what must hold for the outcome, up to 64.

criterion.description: revise: the new criterion, or the replacement for the one with its id.

endpoint.description: start: where the work stops, as authorized (local changes, an open PR, ...).

evidence.description: evidence: one check, at the revision get returned before it ran.

note.description: advance, block, resume and revise: why, in a sentence.

outcome.description: start: the observable result the work delivers.

phase.description: advance: plan, implement, verify, review, then delivery.

requestId.description: Any stable id you choose (letters, digits, _ . -). Repeating a call with the same id does nothing twice.

runId.description: Every action but list: the run's id, chosen at start (letters, digits, _ . -).

version.description: Every change after start: the version the last result returned. A mismatch means the run changed; get it again.

x-ace-constraint: start needs runId, requestId, outcome, endpoint and criteria; get needs runId; advance needs runId, requestId, version, phase and note; block and resume need runId, requestId, version and note; evidence needs runId, requestId, version and evidence; revise needs runId, requestId, version, criterion and note.
